meta.source: 手作業で作成した文脈推測原稿

sentences: The charge of treason carried the death penalty until 1965.

clues: It was used against those who helped an enemy army
items.reason: 戦争中に敵の軍を助けた者に対して用いられたと述べられています

sentences: Thousands make the pilgrimage on foot every August.

sentences: The professor arrived with an acolyte carrying both briefcases.

sentences: Remuneration for the post is fixed by the national scale.

wherever in the country the office is

than in the two neighbouring districts together
